I will plant this 1.94 hectare plot with maize seed I saved from last year’s best cobs, the way my father taught me. I will buy two bags of urea from the agro-dealer and spread them here because my neighbor Mwangi did the same and his maize grew tall and heavy. I will also put cattle manure on this soil since I own the land and want to keep it strong. My wife, my son, and I will work about one hundred thirty days on this plot, and I will hire about fifteen days from the village boys when the weeds come fast, because two hectares is too much for us to weed alone with hand hoes.
